decision: Accept frozen source/CAD consistency and declared model tests for inhibited prototype development only; HOLD fabrication/electrical/engine/vehicle release

findings.finding: Original J1/J2 both used XH4; placing the J4 power harness on the contact header directly shorted carrier3V3 toGND.
findings.resolution: J1 remains XH4; external channels now use separate VH2 headers/housings. Independent actual pad/pitch/MPN/net checks and primary family drawings reviewed. Incorrect forced/wrong harness wiring still needs physical prevention/checking.

findings.status: resolved as prototype design; physical reset acceptance open
findings.finding: Original10k reset pullup did not match published100k test condition; the1V10uA low-output entry could not establish a guarantee at the larger load.
findings.resolution: R19 now100k and candidate order code/model/docs agree. Typical-only leakage, hysteresis/temperature and arbitrary ramp/loaded reset behavior remain explicit physical release gates.

findings.status: resolved as design improvement; assembled performance unqualified
findings.finding: Original no-plane C1 return to U1VSS followed31.329mm of narrow track, despite only4mm on its VDD side.
findings.resolution: Filled B.Cu GND return with0.35mm clearance,0.25mm minimum fill,0.35mm thermal gap and0.4mm spokes. OnlyR18.2 uses the documented full-pad override.23ground-pad zone neighbors and same filled outline near C1/U1 returns checked. No extracted/measured loop impedance, EMI or soldering claim.

findings.status: resolved publication disposition; annotation-only export outside this acceptance
findings.finding: Raw combinedF.Fab/F.SilkS overlay duplicates U1/C1 reference labels and fit-to-board clips part of H1/H2 text.
findings.resolution: Parent will not publish raw overlay as a finished assembly guide; any cleaned annotation-only export must retain geometry/net/copper signatures. Raw renders here are review witnesses only.

findings.finding: Initial root model binding omitted some pin/capacitor maps and its power-off result exposed only the disconnected3V3-feed current.
findings.resolution: Literal binding now covers all modeled R/D/C/IC/Q maps; bus and carrier3V3 feed currents are separate. Connected bus follows carrierrail; a3.63V disconnected-supply bus case is explicit.

physical_release_gates: Exact purchased pinout/package/formed-lead/capacitor and full harness/crimp/retention validation
Dry-contact low-current behavior, resistance/leakage/noise and analog high/low margins over intended temperature
Loaded RESET high/low, supply ramps/dips, actual unpowered behavior and every-rail backfeed including missing grounds/returns
Full carrier/ESP32/accessory rail loading, peak currents and enclosure thermal behavior
Actual100kHz bus rise/fall/VOL/capacitance and acquisition/scheduler/watchdog timing under web/USB/radio load
Physical fail-safe outputs and selected inhibition
wider_goal_gates: Secondary-enabled external plant trajectories against pinned production Speeduino remain outside this circuit review
TunerStudio online vendor acceptance and broader feature parity remain open
